scope: Restricted-runner verification; synthetic browser providers, not native semantic evidence

gates.limitation: Existing theme/font proof warnings; built-only check omits JSX conventions

checks.detail: Minute coalescing/idle, independent trees, IDs-only state, folds/selection/beside/expanded viewport restore, narrow chat and messages unchanged

PASS: cursor-anchored wheel zoom, Ctrl-wheel isolation, background pan, menu isolation, drag without opening, edge/source association, body click, keyboard open and exact source reveal (synthetic fixture).
PASS: zoom percentage, fit nodes, collapsed navigation, pointer and keyboard menu, Escape focus restoration, tree navigation.
PASS: long, short, unanswered, streaming, failed and interrupted previews; two-line clamp, exact source, navigation and reload.
PASS: nested folds, keyboard and focus, visible edges/fit, saved position, ongoing fixture turn, and new child path reveal.
PASS: bulk folds, keyboard action, collapsed-panel selection, path and descendants, sibling fold, saved content.
PASS: desktop sidebar geometry, default navigation, drafts, map pan during reply, late reply isolation, collapse and reopen.
PASS: expand/collapse/back at 1440 and 390, resize with draft and live reply, exact map view restored, focus restored, reduced motion skips transitions (view transitions supported: true).
PASS: selection-only actions, repeated emoji mouse selection, question editing/cancel/focus, keyboard selection and saved anchor.
PASS: empty map start, starter panel close/reopen without node, failed send keeps draft and saves nothing, retry creates exactly one root, child visible and opens, saved tree unchanged.
